column1: # TITLE: A gene expression signature associated with K-Ras addiction reveals regulators of EMT and tumor cell survival

column2: two classes were identified—lines that do or do not require K-Ras to maintain viability. Comparing these two classes of cancer cells revealed a gene expression signature in K-Ras-dependent cells
column3: associated with a well-differentiated epithelial phenotype
column4: which was also seen in primary tumors. Several of these genes encode pharmacologically tractable proteins
column5: such as Syk and Ron kinases and integrin beta6
